meta.name: background-removal
meta.description: Remove backgrounds from images with BiRefNet via inference.sh CLI. Model: BiRefNet (high accuracy background removal). Use for: product photos, portraits, e-commerce, transparent PNGs, photo editing. Triggers: remove background, background removal, remove bg, transparent background, cut out image, background remover, rembg, product photo editing, cutout, transparent png, bg removal, photo cutout

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键去除图片背景，生成透明PNG
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速去除图片背景并导出透明图
copy.tagline_en: Remove image backgrounds instantly for transparent PNGs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly remove backgrounds from images

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 BiRefNet 模型去除图片背景，返回透明背景的 PNG 图片。
howto.when: 当你要求去除图片背景、制作透明 PNG 或编辑产品照片时触发。

say.text: 帮我去掉这张照片的背景。
say.note: Claude 会调用 BiRefNet 处理图片。

say.text: 把这张产品图背景变透明。
say.note: Claude 会生成透明背景的 PNG。
Claude 会处理并返回无背景图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can remove backgrounds from images using the BiRefNet model via inference.sh CLI, returning a PNG with transparent background.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to remove background, make transparent, or edit product photos.

say_en.text: Remove the background from this photo.
say_en.note: Claude will process it with BiRefNet.

say_en.text: Make the background of this product image transparent.
say_en.note: Claude will output a transparent PNG.

say_en.text: Cut out the subject from this portrait.
say_en.note: Claude will return the image without background.
